data.name: Sameyak
data.gender_notes: Sameyak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sameyak is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Same', which means 'truth'. The name 'Yak' is derived from the word 'Yajna', which means 'sacrifice' or 'ritual'. The name Sameyak, therefore, means 'one who performs truthful rituals'. The name Sameyak carries the meaning “Truthful, Balanced” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sameyak usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, balanced and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sameyak is a powerful name that is believed to bring balance and truth to one's life. It is a name that is often given to children who are destined to become spiritual leaders or teachers. It is a name that is associated with the God of Fire, Agni, and is believed to bring the blessings of Agni to the one who bears this name.
data.etymology: Sameyak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful, Balanced.”
